On Friday, Meta shares fell about 4% after gaining 4.5% the previous session, sending Zuckerberg’s estimated net worth down $8.9 billion to $257.5 billion, according to Forbes.
Goldman Sachs warned that AI hyperscalers, including Meta, face a massive revenue hurdle as they pour money into AI infrastructure.

The firm estimated that hyperscalers would need roughly $300 billion in annual AI services revenue just to break even on their capital spending and users would need to spend roughly $1 trillion in annual AI application spending for hyperscalers to generate solid returns.
